observations: Official exterior shows red brick, pale projected bay piers/bands, dark window frames, metal-clad top storey and raised north-west polygonal corner. Warm project palette retained.

Floor 1 has a broad curved west shop facade; floors 2–10 have a straight west wall, a middle faceted bay and north-west polygonal corner. Extruding the entire GIS footprint to 11 floors would be incorrect.
Floor 11 removes the two north projected bays and west mid-wall bay, retaining the corner unit.
The plan north frontage faces the Commonwealth / Questrom side; plan right is west, corroborated by 566 tower to the east (left in street photo).

inferenceLimits: Official plans are diagrammatic and undimensioned. Rear small recesses retain City outline; exact upper facade depths and row/pane dimensions are estimated from plans/photos.
116 feet applies to the published building-height datum. The corner cap is represented 1.693 m above it from exterior proportions, not a surveyed height.

No occupied interiors are invented; structural floor plates prevent through-building sky/light. Rear apertures follow plan window sides approximately and are not claimed as complete as-built elevations.
No new street trees, signs, vehicles or unseen roof equipment are inferred.
566 Commonwealth (City1373) is separately registered as private context; independent source/module owns its geometry.
Desktop and mobile use the same bounded 580 silhouette/opening geometry; total district mobile budget must be checked after rebake.

Ground storefronts are bounded shell/frame geometry from the plan and exterior. Exact entrance threshold/steps, retail signage and current tenant fit-out remain uncalibrated; this does not claim completed near-view storefront reconstruction.

findings: The previously missing 580 frontage is present in the actual desktop scene; twin projected bay strips, north-west corner and upper metal storey are distinct from generic campus blocks.
The curved shop ground envelope is separated from the upper straight west wall rather than extruded as a tall cylinder.

Current views are limited. Storefront entry/steps, precise window spacing/frame material and unseen rear elevations remain incomplete. Actual mobile rebake, walking clearance and additional exterior directions are validated separately by the root task.
Nearby Metcalf still shows generic windows and through-building shadow artifacts; this geometry change is scoped to 580 and must not be presented as full opposing-block realism.
